title: Fema / RBI | RBI (Non-Banking Financial Companies – Securitisation Transactions) Amendment Directions, 2026
description: From 1 April 2027, RBI requires demat NBFC securitisation notes and a ₹1 crore ticket size, with an amortisation exception and SEBI rules for public offers.The post RBI (Non-Banking Financial Companies – Securitisation Transactions) Amendment Directions, 2026 appeared first on TaxGuru.
